title: Blob integration + interaction + performance + README + the W15 four-side carry
summary: Restores the WCAG-2.2.2 DockBackgroundToggle pause/resume seam (v-model:paused, RATIFIED), converts the perpetual onscreen-idle loop into an event-scheduled quiescent one, hoists the duplicated var()-unwrap into ONE dom/ resolveTokenColor leaf (renderer DOM-free), tightens the offscreen-park one-writer-per-reason invariant (off-screen-io key), folds the pre-FBM bounding-discard perf trim, re-casts the multi-mount blob grids onto WatercolorDot (bound the WebGL-context cap), wires the live DockBackgroundToggle pause-seam demo, swept the README planned->landed + defaults-currency, and RECONCILED the W15 four-side-containment gate to the design's intentional satellite-peek budget. W16 touched NO length/geometry constant (W08/W15 own the distance regime).

rediagnosis.ritual: Read the ACTUAL current goo-blob code at HEAD e32d944; confirmed the spec's foldsFindings root causes are REAL with line/symbol citations. NOTE: HEAD is e32d944 (the W15 four-side carry commit), one ahead of the spec's stated eaba94f baseline — the A/B+C/D/E bands (W08+W15) have LANDED (lit contained droplet, dome std>=9, both-mode legibility, hover-lean). The five born-RED witnesses are still present at e32d944 (they are integration/perf/README, untouched by W08/W15).

redWitnesses.name: pause/resume seam is dead (blocker)
redWitnesses.citation: GooBlob.vue:94 calls useMetaballRenderer({...}) and DISCARDS the return value (no assignment). GooBlob.vue:148 defineExpose({ nudge, setMood, pulse, currentMood: mood.currentMood }) OMITS pause/resume. The renderer DOES return { pause, resume } at useMetaballRenderer.ts:561-570. So blob.value.pause() is undefined at every consumer call site; the README example (README.md:353) optional-chains the undefined and silently no-ops.

redWitnesses.name: demand gate is a no-op onscreen (major)
redWitnesses.citation: useMetaballRenderer.ts:521-523 shouldContinue(){ return !paused }. The :514-515 comment literally reads 'the blob is perpetually animated'. createCanvasLifecycle.ts:106-109 reschedules the rAF IFF shouldContinue() — so an unpaused onscreen idle blob burns a full 60fps rAF (FBMx3 twice/px + OKLCh round-trip) indefinitely. The never-shipped quality:'full'|'half' axis (README.md:287) was never wired.

redWitnesses.name: multi-instance context cap (major)
redWitnesses.citation: Each <GooBlob> grabs its own webgl2 context (useWebGLCanvas.ts:110, one getContext per canvas; the cap is named '~8 in Chromium' at :124 and WEBGL_lose_context fires only on teardown). The goo-blob story mounts 5 live <GooBlob> (4 grid + 1 live-color), blob-mood 2, blob-interaction 1; the IntersectionPause park stops the rAF but does NOT release the context. Git archaeology: 9427536 'fix(blob): lazy-mount via IntersectionObserver — Chrome MCP audit caught WebGL context-cap exhaustion'.

redWitnesses.name: duplicated var()-unwrap leaks DOM into the renderer (minor + DRY)
redWitnesses.citation: GooBlob.vue:75-88 resolveColorString AND useMetaballRenderer.ts:159-173 resolveRimColor BOTH do el.style.color + getComputedStyle to un-wrap var(--token). The renderer reaches BACK into the canvas element for a getComputedStyle (useMetaballRenderer.ts:354,462), coupling the pure-fn ColorResolver contract (AT.W0 inv-K-3 seam) to a DOM read it was built to avoid. grep getComputedStyle finds it in BOTH files.

redWitnesses.name: README planned<->landed drift, both directions (minor)
redWitnesses.citation: README.md:120 lists pause()/resume() in the 'Exposed' table but GooBlob.vue:148 does NOT expose them. README.md 'Planned — AW' marks deriveBlobPalette/iridescence/SSS/composed-rest-pose as planned but they SHIPPED (953fdf4/365a2e5 + useBlobPointer.rest()). README defaults also stale: lists bodyRadius 0.25 / satelliteRadius 0.13 / orbitRadius 0.35 (README.md:138-139,165) but the shipped BLOB_CONFIG_DEFAULTS is 0.22 / 0.082 / 0.17 (types.ts:192-195). pointerAttraction default listed 0.0 but shipped 0.35; lit OFF-by-default in README but shipped lit:true.

redWitnesses.name: offscreen-park one-writer-per-reason latent breach (minor)
redWitnesses.citation: createCanvasLifecycle.ts:154-158 (content-visibility path) writes the 'off-screen' reason key; useMetaballRenderer.ts:188-189 (IntersectionObserver fallback path) ALSO writes 'off-screen'. Two writers of the SAME reason key — an IO resume() can lift a legitimately-skipped CV suspend. The substrate is the MODEL (Set<reason> owner discipline); the ONLY fix is giving the IO fallback its OWN 'off-screen-io' key.

w15CarryReconciliation.problem: tests-visual/blob-render.spec.ts now measures the visible WRAPPER footprint correctly (FOOTPRINT_INSET = 0.1875 — the canvas is 160% of the wrapper). The blob BODY is contained (~0.22 interior coverage), the lit dome (std>=9), silhouette CV, both-mode legibility, and hover-lean are VERIFIED. But the orbiting SATELLITES intentionally overflow and cross the footprint edge; the spec's SIDE_MARGIN_MAX_FRAC=0.35 ceil is exceeded by the worst-edge satellite peek (~0.50 at orbit 0.17). W16 touches NO length constant, so the orbit cannot be retuned — the reconciliation is in the GATE: re-derive the four-side ceil to the design's intentional-overflow budget (a satellite PEEK is allowed; a BODY clip is not).
w15CarryReconciliation.decision: FINAL (revised against the LIVE headless render during impl): a SINGLE re-derived four-side ceil bounding the design's intentional satellite-overflow budget — option (B). The initial dual-measure idea (a middle-50% PEEK ceil + a full-span BODY-CLIP guard) did NOT cleanly separate the two on the live render: the worst satellite excursion paints ≈0.49 of the FULL edge span over the peak frame at orbit 0.17, so a full-span body-clip guard at 0.45 false-RED on the legitimate satellite peek. The faithful reconciliation: the BODY is contained BY CONSTRUCTION at the shipped defaults (W15 geometry — body at 0.22 UV × POS_SCALE 0.625 ≈ 36% canvas-half, nowhere near the edge), and the ONLY thing reaching the footprint edge is the orbiting satellite (the intentional overflow). A BODY clip / flood is a DIFFERENT failure mode the EXISTING witnesses already catch: a flood pushes interior coverage above COVERAGE_MAX 0.55 (assertion #1 — flood reads ≈0.74) AND collapses the centre-vs-corner gradient (assertion #2 — flood is alpha=1 everywhere). So the four-side ceil's job is purely to BOUND the satellite excursion: SIDE_MARGIN_MAX_FRAC raised 0.35 -> 0.6 (the full-span worst-edge, ≈0.49 observed → 0.6 so a runaway-orbit regression still reds). Removed the speculative dual measure (EDGE_SPAN_INSET + BODY_CLIP_MAX_FRAC) — no-overfitting. Orbiting character preserved, NO length touched (W16 owns the footprint budget per the spec); the body-clip case is owned by the coverage+gradient witnesses.

rediagnosis.runtimeReasoning: The W01 lesson: headless build/units pass while the live runtime can break — I CANNOT run a real browser. Reasoning precisely about RUNTIME behavior of each arm: (1) PAUSE SEAM — v-model:paused threads props.paused into a watch that calls renderer.pause()/resume(); renderer.pause() sets the local paused=true AND calls canvasHandle.suspend('manual'). suspend() (createCanvasLifecycle.ts:125) adds 'manual' to the Set and cancelAnimationFrame's the live rAF — the loop PARKS (isRunning()===false). resume('manual') deletes it and, if the set is now empty + armed, restarts tick(). So the DockBackgroundToggle @update:paused -> v-model write -> watch -> pause()/resume() chain ACTUALLY parks/restarts the substrate rAF at runtime. The static defineExpose-string gate cannot see this; only the live rAF-park observation can. (2) QUIESCENCE — shouldContinue() now ORs every live-motion source (mood transitioning OR pending auto-mood arc, pointer spring |v|>eps, trail non-empty, click pulse !=0, any satellite mid-merge/emerge/absorbed) AND a satellite-phase wake horizon. When ALL are at rest, shouldContinue() returns false -> createCanvasLifecycle stops rescheduling -> the loop PARKS onscreen. The satellite scheduler exposes nextEventMs(); the renderer schedules a setTimeout wake() at that horizon so the parked loop RE-ARMS exactly when the next orbit/merge phase is due — no frozen blob, no polling. FALSE-PARK hazard: the predicate ORs every motion source using the SAME state the renderer already reads each frame; the first-post-park dt clamp (useMetaballRenderer.ts:289-291 + useBlobPointer.ts:117) prevents a jump on re-arm. (3) DOM-FREE — the SFC now un-wraps base + rim + every palette stop via the resolveTokenColor leaf BEFORE handing concrete strings to the renderer; the renderer's resolveRimColor + rimCache DELETE, so getComputedStyle appears EXACTLY ONCE (in the leaf). (4) OFF-SCREEN-IO — the IO fallback writes 'off-screen-io' (a distinct reason key), so an IO resume can no longer lift a CV suspend; the loop runs only when the Set is empty (both agree visible). (5) CONTEXT CAP — the multi-mount grids re-cast to WatercolorDot (zero GL context); ONE interactive <GooBlob> hero remains per story, so the live GL-context count is bounded at 1-2/page. (6) PERF TRIM — the pre-FBM bounding early-out writes vec4(0.0) and returns BEFORE the two FBM calls for any fragment outside uMaxReach (padded by bodyR+orbitR+satR+uSmoothK+noiseAmp), saving the transparent-border ALU; the 4-tap gate is MOOT (W15 already landed the analytic-gradient normal — there IS no 4-tap to gate, recorded as a no-op note). LIVE-VERIFY is the binding close: the orchestrator must run proof:blob-render (four-side reconciled) + the pause-seam π-lane on the real Metal GPU.
rediagnosis.selfGateCaveat: Headless build/units/typecheck/glslang all pass; they DO NOT prove the live rAF parks on pause, the idle loop quiesces, the satellite scheduler wakes it, the context count is bounded, or the perf trim is correct on a real GPU. Those are the orchestrator's π-lane obligations (liveVerifyNeeded below). I reasoned about each at runtime but could not execute a real browser.

ratify.decision: v-model:paused (RECOMMENDED path b) — the declarative, structurally-un-droppable seam, PLUS pause()/resume() re-exposed on defineExpose (the hybrid).
ratify.consumerSurvey: Grepped demo/ + src/ for imperative blob.value.pause()/resume() call sites: ZERO live consumers (the only references are in DOCS — README.md:353 example + DockBackgroundToggle.vue:24 JSDoc). No imperative call site must keep working, so v-model:paused can OWN the default declarative path with zero migration cost.
ratify.rationale: v-model:paused matches the shape DockBackgroundToggle already wears (v-model:paused host reflecting aria-pressed, CLAUDE.md §DockBackgroundToggle), makes the seam STRUCTURALLY un-droppable (a discarded renderer return cannot recur — the prop write drives pause() directly), and reaches PARITY with Aurora's useAurora pause()/resume(). pause()/resume() ALSO stay on defineExpose (re-exposed from the captured renderer return) so the README imperative example + the Aurora-parity imperative API hold. Both bind the SAME renderer pause()/resume() — NO parallel pause path (the precept). The prop owns the declarative default; the imperative handles are the secondary surface.
ratify.publicSurfaceDelta: GooBlob gains a paused?: boolean prop + an update:paused emit (the v-model pair) AND keeps pause()/resume() on defineExpose. A quality?: 'full'|'half' config field is added to BlobConfig (the never-shipped axis, now wired).

arms.arm1_pauseSeam: v-model:paused on GooBlob.vue: capture const { pause, resume } = useMetaballRenderer({...}); add a paused prop + update:paused emit; watch(() => props.paused) -> pause()/resume(); re-expose pause/resume on defineExpose. Binds the EXISTING renderer seam.
arms.arm2_quiescence: useMetaballRenderer.ts shouldContinue() replaced with a real at-rest predicate ORing every motion source; useBlobMood.ts exposes isSettled() (transitioning + excitedHold + pending auto-mood arc); useBlobPointer.ts exposes isAtRest() (spring |v|<eps + trail empty + pulse 0); useBlobSatellites.ts exposes isQuiescent() + nextEventMs() (phase scheduler). The renderer schedules a wake() at nextEventMs so the parked loop re-arms on the next satellite phase. quality:'full'|'half' wired (half-res backing store on the metaball pass via a DPR halving).
arms.arm3_contextCap: demo stories re-cast: goo-blob.vue + blob-mood.vue multi-mount blob grids -> WatercolorDot (zero GL context) for the static/ambient register; ONE interactive <GooBlob> hero retained per story; blob-interaction.vue keeps its single hero + gains the DockBackgroundToggle pause-seam section.
arms.arm4_resolveTokenColor: NEW src/composables/dom/useResolveTokenColor.ts — resolveTokenColor(css, el): concreteCss, ONE cached getComputedStyle cascade read. GooBlob.vue un-wraps base + rim + every palette stop via the leaf BEFORE the renderer; useMetaballRenderer.ts DELETES resolveRimColor + rimCache (receives concrete strings only — DOM-free). getComputedStyle appears EXACTLY ONCE (the leaf). NOTE: distinct from the adjacent useTokenColor (reads a property by NAME); no seam collision (resolveTokenColor un-wraps an arbitrary color STRING).
arms.arm5_perfTrim: metaball.frag.ts: pre-FBM bounding EARLY-OUT (if length(uv) > uMaxReach { fragColor = vec4(0.0); return; }) BEFORE the two FBM calls; uMaxReach is a NEW uniform PADDED by bodyR + orbitR + satR + uSmoothK + noiseAmp (the smin-band + meniscus). Transparent WRITE, not discard (premultiplied blend, no depth; discard kills the mobile tiled fast path). The surfaceNormal 4-tap gate is MOOT — W15 already landed the analytic-gradient normal (sceneDistG returns vec3(d,grad); the 4-tap is DELETED), recorded as a no-op note. The 1.6x oversize trim is NOT taken in W16 (POS_SCALE/oversize is the W08/W15 length regime — out of bounds; the pre-FBM discard captures the same fill saving without a length edit).
arms.arm6_offScreenIo: createCanvasLifecycle.ts CanvasSuspendReason union gains 'off-screen-io'; useMetaballRenderer.ts IO fallback writes suspend('off-screen-io')/resume('off-screen-io') — distinct from the CV path's 'off-screen'. One writer per reason; the loop runs only when the Set is empty (both agree visible).
arms.arm7_readme: README.md authored in the canonical-readme-shape: planned->landed sweep (iridescence/SSS/palette/composed-rest-pose flipped to shipped), the Exposed table fixed (pause/resume present, paused prop documented), the BlobConfig defaults made CURRENT (bodyRadius 0.22, satelliteRadius 0.082, orbitRadius 0.17, pointerAttraction 0.35, lit true, the quiescence/quality axes documented). README-vs-code consistency check added to the gate.
